name: Gourmet x Eagle
source: In an age when the health of soldiers is important the protagonist is born and becomes a cook for the military. But she isn't acknowledged by the stiff majors and is ridiculed by the private. By cooking nice food can she become better acquainted with those annoying soldiers?
translation: 在一个重视军人健康的时代，主角诞生并成为军队的厨师。但她并没有得到僵硬的专业人士的认可，还受到私人的嘲笑。通过烹饪美味的食物，她能更好地熟悉那些烦人的士兵吗？
